quality_guards: Environment Agency incident reports are regulatory triage inputs and do not guarantee investigation or reporter status updates.
Bathing-water annual classifications use up to four years of samples and are not real-time measurements.
Pollution-risk forecasts do not identify sewage as the contamination source and remain temporary site advice.
Priority Services Register support depends on consumer circumstances and provider enrolment.
Power-cut compensation depends on event cause, duration and network-company responsibility.
The National Gas Emergency line is reserved for gas smells and suspected carbon monoxide, not ordinary appliance faults.
MHRA catalogue counts and visible latest notices are timestamped changing snapshots.
Field Safety Notices remain manufacturer and model specific and require product-level action.
Yellow Card reports are safety signals and do not by themselves establish causation.
DVSA recalls and registered faults are separated; optional fault action is not interpreted as a completed recall.
Vehicle and medical-product alerts are not converted into parcel-level safety scores.
Current official-source verification does not replace 130-candidate/16-endpoint live parity, browser DOM/console acceptance, commit ancestry, publisher push or remote readback.
